_comment: Every compose.prod.yml service with a build context. CI (image-build, image-test-push and publish-images in .github/workflows/ci.yml) runs a matrix over `images`, so nothing is hardcoded: add an entry here (and the service in compose.prod.yml) to build and ship a new container. `service` becomes the GHCR image suffix: ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>-<service>, lower-cased from the repository name. `context` and `dockerfile` are repo-relative. migrate and worker run the backend image; postgres, redis, seaweedfs, meilisearch, centrifugo and wuzapi are upstream images and are not listed.
